@Conor Hadlington is the new general manager of Conrad Hong Kong, the 513-room hotel above Pacific Place in Admiralty.

He took up the role on 28 September. Originally from the UK, he brings about 18 years in luxury hotels across Asia, the United States and the Middle East, with Mandarin Oriental, InterContinental and Shangri-La.

He started in food and beverage before moving into commercial and hotel-wide leadership. For @Conrad Hotels & Resorts, he now oversees operations, commercial strategy and brand standards in Admiralty.

The signal: @Hilton has chosen a GM with a commercial background for one of its large city hotels in Asia, where rooms, events and dining must all perform at once.

Congratulations, Conor, on this new role.
